# Generated by make_contract_events.py. Contract schemes for the Mishpacha contracts that are long work: one type per
# contract and skill, since the approach chosen when the contract is taken decides the skill. Modelled on vanilla's
# laamp contract schemes, but executed into our own events (jip_contract_scheme_prep_effect).

# Fitting Out the Caravan, by stewardship
jip_contract_caravan_stewardship_scheme = {
	skill = stewardship
	desc = jip_contract_caravan_scheme_desc_general
	success_desc = jip_contract_scheme_desc_success
	icon = stewardship
	illustration = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_travel_desert.dds"
	target_type = character
	category = contract

	speed_per_skill_point = t2_spsp_owner_value
	base_progress_goal = t3_base_phase_length_value
	base_maximum_success = t3_base_max_success_value
	phases_per_agent_charge = 1
	success_chance_growth_per_skill_point = laamp_contract_scgpsp_value
	spymaster_speed_per_skill_point = 0
	uses_resistance = no

	valid = {
		jip_contract_scheme_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	agent_leave_threshold = -25
	agent_join_chance = {
		base = 0
		ai_agent_join_chance_laamp_contract_modifier = yes
	}
	valid_agent = { is_valid_agent_standard_trigger = yes }
	agent_groups_owner_perspective = { courtiers }

	base_success_chance = {
		base = 0
		scheme_type_skill_success_chance_modifier = { SKILL = STEWARDSHIP }
		laamp_contract_scheme_basic_success_chance_modifier = yes
		jip_contract_scheme_stewardship_success_modifier = yes
	}

	on_phase_completed = {
		suppress_scheme_follow_up_event_till_input_given_effect = yes
		jip_contract_scheme_prep_effect = { EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0032 }
		cap_schemes_and_fire_reminders_effect = yes
	}
	on_hud_click = { jip_contract_scheme_prep_effect = { EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0032 } }
	on_invalidated = { jip_contract_scheme_invalidated_effect = yes }
}

# Fitting Out the Caravan, by diplomacy
jip_contract_caravan_diplomacy_scheme = {
	skill = diplomacy
	desc = jip_contract_caravan_scheme_desc_general

	icon = diplomacy

	base_maximum_success = t3_base_max_success_value
	phases_per_agent_charge = 1
	success_chance_growth_per_skill_point = laamp_contract_scgpsp_value
	spymaster_speed_per_skill_point = 0
	uses_resistance = no

	valid = {
		jip_contract_scheme_valid_trigger = yes
	}

	agent_leave_threshold = -25
	agent_join_chance = {
		base = 0
		ai_agent_join_chance_laamp_contract_modifier = yes
	}
	valid_agent = { is_valid_agent_standard_trigger = yes }
	agent_groups_owner_perspective = { courtiers }

	base_success_chance = {
		base = 0
		scheme_type_skill_success_chance_modifier = { SKILL = DIPLOMACY }
		laamp_contract_scheme_basic_success_chance_modifier = yes
		jip_contract_scheme_diplomacy_success_modifier = yes

	on_phase_completed = {
		suppress_scheme_follow_up_event_till_input_given_effect = yes
		jip_contract_scheme_prep_effect = { EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0032 }
		cap_schemes_and_fire_reminders_effect = yes
	}
	on_hud_click = { jip_contract_scheme_prep_effect = { EVENT = jip_mishpacha_contract.0032 } }
	on_invalidated = { jip_contract_scheme_invalidated_effect = yes }
}
